features.description: Engineered with smart automation and precision technology for reliable, efficient, and high-performance textile printing

items.title: 16-Head High-Speed Maglev System
items.desc: Sixteen Epson i3200-A1 heads mounted on a magnetic levitation carriage deliver maximum productivity with stable, precise high-speed movement across the full 1900 mm print width.

items.title: THK Silent Dual Guide Rail
items.desc: Premium THK dual rail system minimises carriage vibration and operational noise, ensuring consistent print sharpness and a comfortable working environment during sustained high-speed production.

items.title: External Multi-Stage Drying System
items.desc: Combined wind and heat drying in a dedicated external multi-stage unit ensures rapid, thorough ink fixation at maximum print speeds, improving turnaround time and reducing output defects.

items.title: Air-Guided Suction Platform
items.desc: Active air suction across the print zone holds transfer paper flat against the platform, preventing media bulging, improving alignment accuracy, and ensuring defect-free output throughout every run.

items.title: 25-Litre Ink Supply with Syphon System
items.desc: High-capacity 25-litre per colour ink tanks with syphon delivery maintain consistent ink pressure and flow to all 16 heads, supporting very long uninterrupted production runs with minimal refill stops.

items.title: 3,000-Metre Unwinding Capability
items.desc: Jumbo roll support for up to 3,000 metres of transfer paper enables extended non-stop production batches, significantly reducing roll change frequency and operator intervention on large orders.

items.title: AC Servo Motor with High-Precision Reducer
items.desc: Industrial AC servo motor paired with a high-precision reducer delivers smooth, stable media feeding with precise speed control and consistent transport performance across long production hours.

items.title: Auto Moisture and Cleaning System
items.desc: Automated printhead moisture control and cleaning cycle maintains consistent nozzle performance throughout the production shift without requiring manual intervention between jobs.

items.title: Unattended Automated Production
items.desc: Advanced board control technology enables fully unattended automated production schemes, achieving production speeds of up to 590 sqm/h with minimal operator intervention.

items.title: Multi-Position Guide Roller & Plue Roller Feeding
items.desc: Multi-position guide rollers keep the material paper uniform for high-precision output free of press-wheel marks and wrinkles, while the Plue roller feeding system keeps the material stable and neat.

items.title: Thickened Wall Panel Structure
items.desc: A thickened wall panel structure ensures structural stability for long-term high-speed operation, supporting consistent registration and print quality.

idealFor.description: Perfectly suited for a wide range of textile applications, delivering exceptional print quality, color vibrancy, and production efficiency across diverse fabric categories.

fabrics.title: Maximum-Volume Sublimation Transfer Paper Production
fabrics.desc: The highest-output Alpha series sublimation printer for manufacturers supplying very large volumes of printed transfer paper to heat press operations across polyester garment and fashion fabric markets.

fabrics.title: Large-Scale Polyester Fashion Fabric Printing
fabrics.desc: Direct sublimation output on polyester sarees, dress materials, and fashion fabrics for wholesale and export operations where daily output volume and colour consistency are the primary business requirements.

fabrics.title: Sportswear and Activewear Production at Industrial Scale
fabrics.desc: High-speed sublimation on polyester performance fabrics for major sportswear brands, gym wear producers, and activewear exporters running continuous large-volume order pipelines.

fabrics.title: Industrial Home Textile Sublimation Production
fabrics.desc: Very high-capacity sublimation printing on polyester curtains, cushion covers, upholstery fabrics, and decorative soft furnishings for large domestic and export home textile markets.

fabrics.title: Round-the-Clock Multi-Shift Operations
fabrics.desc: Maglev carriage, THK silent dual rail, 3,000-metre roll support, and 25-litre bulk ink supply are designed specifically for facilities running 24-hour multi-shift continuous production schedules.

fabrics.title: Large Job Work and Multi-Buyer Sublimation Units
fabrics.desc: Highest daily output in the Alpha range combined with stable multi-hour operation makes the Alpha 16 the top choice for large job work printers managing high-volume diverse client order portfolios.

fabrics.title: Apparel, Home Decor, and Promotional Fabric Production
fabrics.desc: Versatile sublimation capability across transfer paper and direct polyester fabric substrates suits manufacturers serving multiple end markets from a single production platform.

fabrics.title: T-Shirt Printing
fabrics.desc: Vibrant sublimation transfer printing for polyester T-shirts and apparel at high volume.

fabrics.title: Canvas Bags
fabrics.desc: Durable, full-colour sublimation prints on polyester canvas bags and promotional carry products.

fabrics.title: Cushions
fabrics.desc: High-coverage sublimation on polyester cushion covers and soft furnishings for home decor production.

fabrics.title: Scooters and Vehicle Wraps
fabrics.desc: Sublimation transfer for polyester-based scooter seat covers, wraps, and personalised vehicle textiles.

fabrics.title: Flags and Textile Fabrics
fabrics.desc: Bright, fade-resistant sublimation printing on polyester flags, banners, and general textile fabrics.
